_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Pela Snake i luga o se {width}×{height} grid.
E te kontrola snake {player_id}. Siʻi talafeagai: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (poʻo w/s/a/d).
Faʻamoemoe: maua le umi atu mo se taimi umi pe afai o le umi atu ma maua le faʻailoga sili (faʻailoga faʻamalosi {max_turns} faʻamalosi).

board.current: Komiti Faatino o loʻo iai nei: {board}
board.after_moves: Setete o le Komiti Faatino i le taimi nei: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} mate lea ua oti ona o le malosi o le siʻi.

outcome.survived_win: Na ola le tagata taalo {player_id}; na maliliu isi uma.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Na feoti uma gata i le taimi e tasi.
outcome.outlived: Na ola le tagata taalo i isi uma.
outcome.turn_limit: Ua oo i le tapulaa o taamilosaga - e manumalo lē ua sili ona lelei lana togi.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Vaega o le faʻaiʻuina o le faʻatau (sili ona leaga→sili ona lelei): {groups}
